messages:
maria: Heads-up: started a partial rollout (10%) for release/2026-11-03 to inference-prod. Noticed a sharp rise in tail latency on the /v1/embeddings route around 18:33 UTC.

deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — service inference-prod: embeddings: p95 latency increased from 120ms -> 460ms, error-rate +4.2% in last 5m. Canary group impacted.

maria: Paging SRE. @sarah can you take a look? I'm leaving the canary paused but traffic is still routing to the new tasks due to in-flight requests.

sarah: On it. Pulling logs from the canary workers. Any recent infra changes besides the model binary?

logan: I only changed the model variant and upgraded runtime from v2.11.0 -> v2.12.0 (minor perf tweak). No infra config changes.

sarah: Seeing a pattern: embeddings requests hitting these pods show repeated KV cache misses. Upstream cache rehydration loops are firing and backend queue length is climbing.

maria: That's the cache warmup we expected, but queue shouldn't blow up. Numbers?

sarah: Current pending queue in the canary pool: ~720 requests (baseline ~15). GPU worker CPU is ok but GPU occupancy is >95% and latency per token is spiking due to repeated full-attention stalls while KV builds.

nikhil: Could be a config default in v2.12 that disabled prefix caching for certain model sizes. Checking the rollout config now.

logan: I pushed a config flag in the release branch to toggle `embed_cache_warmup=true`. Maybe it's inverted in the built image.

maria: We need an immediate mitigation: options = 1) rollback the canary 2) flip feature flag (kill-switch) to force old caching behavior 3) scale the canary pool to absorb rehydration. Thoughts?

olivia: Customer-facing: we already have a support ticket for a high-volume customer noticing degraded embedding latency. They see timeouts. Need ETA for mitigation.

sarah: Short-term: flip the kill-switch for caching if we can do it atomically. If not trivial, rollback.

logan: I can flip the FF `ff/embed_cache_warmup` via UI or CLI. Will that unroll the new runtime behavior? It depends — if the runtime baked an off-by-default path, toggling should restore old path.

nikhil: Confirmed: in v2.12 we accidentally set `cache_mode=auto` which chooses 'cold' for models >7B. Toggling to `cache_mode=warm` forces prefix/KV cache. CLI command: `redwoodctl featureflip set embed_cache_warmup=true --env=prod --scope=canary`

maria: Do it, @logan. And post the command you run.

logan: Running now:
```
redwoodctl featureflip set embed_cache_warmup=true --env=prod --scope=canary --actor=logan
```

deploy-bot: Feature flip applied: embed_cache_warmup=true to canary (release/2026-11-03) by logan at 18:39:12 UTC.

sarah: I'm seeing KV hit-rate starting to climb on those pods. Pending queue dropping from 720 -> 230 within 90s.

maria: Nice. Any errors increasing?

sarah: Error-rate declining. p95 latency trending down: 460ms -> 190ms over last 3m. Still not back to baseline, but improving.

olivia: Notified the customer they should see improvements; asked them to confirm.

maria: Stay monitoring for 15m. If metrics fully recover, we'll continue with a cautious canary resume (2 more % points) otherwise rollback full canary.

logan: FYI I also prepared a rollback patch in case. Command: `redwoodctl rollout undo release/2026-11-03 --target=canary` — not running unless we fail to stabilize.

sarah: Quick note: this is likely the root cause (cache_mode auto -> cold). We should add a preflight check that validates effective cache_mode for model sizes in future rollouts. Filing a follow-up task.

maria: Agreed. We'll file a post-incident action. For now, handoff to @nikhil for night coverage. He'll keep an eye on the canary and customer impact.

nikhil: Taking over. I'll maintain a 5m watch and escalate if queue > 300 or p95 > 300ms for >5m.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident created: 2026-11-03 18:45 UTC — "Partial rollout cache warmup impact on embeddings". Severity: P2. Owner: nikhil.

maria: TL;DR: partial rollout triggered a cache warmup mode that increased KV misses and request queues. We toggled embed_cache_warmup=true at 18:39 UTC; metrics improving. Handoff to nikhil for monitoring. Will update timeline and RCA later.

olivia: I'll keep support looped and ask customer to validate.

nikhil: A few follow-ups I'll do tonight: 1) watch canary metrics for 1h, 2) confirm full rollout gating rule to ensure cache_mode isn't inverted, 3) coordinate with release engineers for a quick patch if needed.

maria: Thanks all. Closing active paging. If anything regresses ping me or @sarah. :thumbsup:

logan: One more: adding a pre-deploy smoke step that simulates cold-cache QPS to catch this. Will open PR tomorrow.

sarah: Noted. Thanks team.

olivia: Customer confirmed improved perf at 18:47 UTC.

maria: Marking incident as mitigated; will convert to a postmortem ticket with RCA and action items.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.

nikhil: Acknowledged handoff. Monitoring now.
